Text: Long-context LLM apps can waste time recomputing KV state they have already seen.

LMCache is a KV cache management layer for builders serving LLMs.

It helps you reduce repeated prefill work and time to first token by storing, offloading, and reusing KV caches across requests, sessions, and serving-engine instances.

Key features:
• Engine-independent deployment – runs as a standalone daemon, separate from the inference engine process.
• Tiered offloading – moves KV caches from GPU memory to CPU RAM, local disk, or remote storage.
• Persistent reuse – shares stored KV state across requests, sessions, and engine instances.
• Cache observability – exposes health, cache-hit, lifecycle, performance, and usage metrics.
• Flexible reuse and transfer – supports non-prefix caching plus prefill-to-decode transfer over NVLink, RDMA, or TCP.

It’s open-source (Apache 2.0 license).
